ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this was a verified driver no-show. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands, and the driver is owed SGD 3.60 as his payout under POL-NS-07 (80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force for this trip, EV-FARE-02721). No refund is due to the rider.

POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four are on the record. (a) EV-TRIP-02721 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 15:11:34. (b) EV-GPS-02721 puts him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — his closest approach to the pin was 0.0 m — with 41 qualifying fixes, far past the 3-fix test of POL-NS-02. (c) He held position there continuously for 400 seconds, 15:11:34 to 15:18:14, against the 180-second free waiting period in force, more than double. (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 15:18:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event.

Your account, rider, does not hold up on your own evidence. The rider track inside the same GPS trace places your device about 725 to 732 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with no qualifying fix inside the 100 m rider-presence radius — you were not at the pickup point. You also sent no message: EV-CHAT-02721 holds exactly one message, the driver's 'im at the pickup point' at 15:11:54, which you read at 15:12:24 and never answered. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you because its limb (a) requires a rider message and there is none.

I checked every clause that could displace the fee. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival timestamp the driver's distance was 0.0 m and his speed 0.0 kph, so the marker is genuine and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 does not fire: 400 seconds against 180 seconds is a surplus, not a shortfall. POL-NS-03 does not apply, as the driver was inside the arrival radius and not at a wrong entrance. POL-NS-10 does not apply, as the rider did not cancel. The driver's own account that he was at the pin for over six minutes is consistent with, but adds nothing to, the trace.

Nothing escalates. The trace is complete (100% coverage, 10 s cadence, no gaps), so POL-NS-08 finds no integrity defect and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged; the profiles show zero same-pair disputes and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1 of 126 completed trips in 30 days is far below 0.08, both limbs being required. The only profile figures this ruling touches are driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d, which are the figures POL-NS-07 names; no context-only profile field was used as a ground.

Two claims were discarded at the citation stage for citing the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02721-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0) without naming its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the advisory's absence changes nothing here, because the driver's single continuous in-geofence run already exceeds the minimum without any accumulation. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the execution threshold, so it executes automatically, and either party may appeal within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver — the platform's records and both parties' accounts line up on the same facts, and this ruling rests on clean, full-weight evidence (EV-TRIP-02721, EV-GPS-02721 and EV-FARE-02721 each carry weight_multiplier 1.0; the only impaired artifact, EV-ADVIS-02721-01 at 0.0, carries no fact this ruling rests on, so it does not cap confidence).

Was the driver there? The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 15:11:34 on 14 Aug 2026 (EV-TRIP-02721). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02721) puts the vehicle inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that exact second and holding position continuously for 400 seconds, with 41 qualifying fixes ending 15:18:14 — well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The trace is complete: 100% coverage, 10-second sampling, no gaps, so no POL-NS-08 integrity impairment applies. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the tap the driver was at the pin (minimum distance 0 m) and stationary (0.0 km/h), not more than 300 m away and not moving at 15 km/h or above.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold: (a) an 'arrived' event exists; (b) the GPS places the driver inside the geofence by 15:11:34; (c) the continuous dwell is 400 s against a 180 s minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap; and (d) the driver terminated the trip at 15:18:15 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, after the required dwell had elapsed. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee: the driver was inside the radius, so the wrong-entrance route (POL-NS-03) does not apply, and the dwell exceeds the minimum by 220 seconds, so the shortfall route (POL-NS-06) does not apply either. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02721-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is immaterial — limb (i) accumulation across intervals is never needed because there is one continuous 400-second run.

Was the rider exonerated? No. POL-NS-04 does not engage. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02721) holds a single message, and it is the driver's — 'im at the pickup point', sent 15:11:54 and read by the rider at 15:12:24. The rider sent nothing during the waiting window, so limb (a) fails; and the rider's own device track (EV-GPS-02721 rider_track) places the rider roughly 725–732 m from the pin throughout, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, so limb (c) would fail as well. The rider's 'I never saw the car' is entirely consistent with that track — the rider was not at the pickup point. The rider's cancellation-grace route under POL-NS-10 does not apply either, because the trip was terminated by the driver and not by the rider.

Who is paid what? The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02721) records the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the charge stands. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is paid 80% of the net fee: 0.80 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 126 completed trips in 30 days is far below 0.08 — both limbs must hold and neither does, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires: the parties have 0 disputes between them in 90 days, rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, confidence is above the 0.70 floor, and no admissible artifacts contradict each other.

Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60 — it is the amount this ruling moves, not a refund to the rider, and the rider's SGD 4.50 charge stands (the disposition of the fee is NO_ACTION, per POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03). The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically subject to the appeal route in POL-GEN-04. No referral is produced: the arrival marker was true, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and RIDER_NO_SHOW was the correct reason code.
